Overview

The National Institute of Technology (NIT) Raipur has released a recruitment notification for 37 non‑faculty posts for the year 2026. The positions are being filled under the 7th Pay Commission salary structure. While the application window remains open, the last date for submission is approaching, prompting interested candidates to review the eligibility criteria and age limits carefully.

Salary and Pay Scale

All posts will be compensated according to the 7th Pay Commission guidelines. The source does not disclose exact pay bands or allowances for each post; applicants are advised to refer to the official NIT Raipur recruitment portal for the detailed pay matrix.

Application Process

The Navbharat Times article notes that applications are still being accepted but does not outline the submission method (online/offline), required documents, or fee structure. Prospective applicants should visit the official NIT Raipur recruitment website (link provided below) to obtain the complete application form, instructions, and any associated fees.

Practical Implications for Job Seekers

  • Short‑listing: Candidates must ensure they meet both the academic and age criteria before investing time in the application. For example, a 31‑year‑old with a qualifying degree would be ineligible for the Superintendent and Technical Assistant roles but could still apply for Senior Assistant or Senior Technician positions, which have a higher age ceiling.
  • Skill Alignment: The Superintendent role explicitly requires computer‑application knowledge, while the Senior Assistant role demands a typing speed of at least 35 wpm. Applicants should be prepared to demonstrate these competencies during any subsequent screening.
  • Regional Competition: NITs across India frequently announce similar non‑faculty vacancies. Compared to recent NIT Tiruchirappalli and NIT Warangal recruitments, the Raipur notice offers a broader range of technical and support positions, potentially attracting a diverse applicant pool.
